newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Waterford Wedgwood backs Rosenthal issue.
newsitem.headline: Waterford Wedgwood backs Rosenthal issue.

text.p: Waterford Wedgwood said on Monday that it had sub-underwritten 86.4 percent of German ceramics firm Rosenthal's 36 million mark rights issue.
Waterford Wedgwood currently owns 9.1 percent of Rosenthal.
The relationship between Waterford Wedgwood and Rosenthal had been further strengthened through increased representation on the board of directors of both companies, it said.

"This is a further demonstration of our belief in the future of Rosenthal. We are confident that the links which we have established will reap benefits for both companies," Waterford Wedgwood said in a statement.

Rosenthal announced in a recent results statement that it had made an operating loss of 4.6 million marks for 1996 compared to a loss of 11.3 million marks the previous year while turnover for the year was 320.4 million marks compared to 330 million marks previously.
In addition, Rosenthal said provisions of 40 million marks had been established to cover future rationalisation and restructuring costs leading to a reported net loss of 48.8 million 1996.

Waterford Wedgwood announced a 24 percent rise in pre-tax profits to 34.9 million punts in its results statement for the year to end December 31, 1996 while turnover was up to 376.3 million Irish pounds compared to 344.5 million previously.
